findings_summary: The three publications are not interchangeable duplicates. TP2-2346 targets the broader composite Franel escape after first-reentry and harmonic-pairing reductions; TP2-D78 freezes an independently replayed bounded forced-midpoint fallback theorem and explicitly leaves its high range open; TP2-DE338 reconstructs the isolated q=3r-1 arithmetic-core boundary from a separate durable checkpoint. Their task_id collision hides distinct research scopes, so all three should remain referenceable and no publication should be deleted or silently superseded.
